name: remarkable-companion
description: Read selected reMarkable notebooks, review page changes, and post new documents through the existing rmk bridge.

interface.longDescription: Review new and edited notebook pages, read handwriting with page references, and send useful briefs, worksheets, PDFs, or EPUBs to reMarkable. Uses the existing rmk connection on your Mac.
defaultPrompt: What has changed in my reMarkable notes since the last review?
Read my selected notebook and summarize decisions and open questions.
Prepare a one-page brief and send it to my reMarkable.
